prompt: Create a cinematic anime-style illustration of a young woman standing outdoors in a snowy open landscape under a vivid deep blue winter sky. She is shown in a close-up three-quarter view from the waist up, positioned on the right side of the frame, smiling softly and looking toward her raised hand. She has short tousled dark brown hair blown by the wind, large expressive gray-blue eyes, delicate facial features, and warm sunlight highlighting her face and hair. She wears a thick cobalt blue winter work jacket with visible seams, zipper pulls, pockets, metal snaps, and a cream ribbed turtleneck sweater underneath. Her left hand is extended toward the left side of the image, index finger pointing outward, and a bright white pixelated zigzag arrow or electric line appears to touch the fingertip, forming one angular rising graph-like shape. In the background, show a vast snow-covered field with low snowy hills, utility pylons, and multiple black power lines stretching diagonally across the sky, creating strong perspective lines. Use crisp detailed anime rendering, high contrast sunlight, subtle shadows, wind-swept hair strands, saturated blues and whites, clean linework, and a widescreen 3:2 composition. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, extra characters, or additional graphic elements.

promptZh: 创作一张电影感动漫风格插画，画面中 一位年轻女性 站在深蓝色冬季天空下的开阔雪地中。画面采用腰部以上的三分之二近景构图，人物位于画面右侧，面带柔和微笑，看向她抬起的手。她留着 凌乱的深棕色短发，随风飘动，拥有一双灵动的大型灰蓝色眼睛和精致的五官，温暖的阳光照亮了她的脸庞和发丝。她穿着一件厚实的 钴蓝色 冬季工装夹克，细节包括明显的接缝、拉链头、口袋和金属按扣，内搭奶油色罗纹高领毛衣。她的左手向画面左侧伸出，食指指向前方，一道明亮的白色像素化锯齿状箭头或电线仿佛触碰到了她的指尖，形成一个类似上升图表的折线形状。背景展现广阔的雪原，点缀着低矮的雪丘、电线塔，多条黑色电线在天空中对角线延伸，营造出强烈的透视感。采用清晰细腻的动漫渲染风格，高对比度阳光，微妙的阴影，随风飘动的发丝，饱和的蓝色与白色调，干净的线条，以及 3:2 的宽屏构图。避免出现文字、Logo、水印、额外角色或其他图形元素。
